verdict.summary: The length bound remains enforced at the ingestion seam with a full-match, fail-closed repository guard. The tests independently pin both accepted maxima and both just-over-limit refusals, include a very large input that detects a conditionally inert guard, and assert both publication and the bounded diagnostic path without deriving boundary inputs from the production regex. The documentation matches the implemented refusal behavior. No correctness, security, or test-validity issue is evident. Compared with round 2, the approved change has materially the same zero findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
